caption: The drawing depicts two human figures standing side by side, both wearing long, brownish-beige garments with long sleeves and high collars. Each figure has a bright red sash tied around their waist, with the ends of the sashes hanging down on their left sides. Both figures are wearing brown shoes or boots. Their facial features are simply drawn, with minimal details, and one figure has short, light-colored hair while the other has a covered or featureless head. The background is plain and uncolored, leaving the figures as the primary focus of the composition. The drawing is signed "Geo. J. File" in the lower right corner, and the entire image appears on a slightly yellowed or aged piece of paper.
title: Woman Doll in Buckskin
